slice.real_problem: M33 made safe retry durable and observable in stored events, but it did not prove that production CLI and TUI keep failure category, retry ordinal, wait, exhaustion reason and the next valid action understandable after subsequent in-flight or terminal projections.
acceptance: inject timeout, reset, 429 with Retry-After, 503, permanent 401, partial SSE and prepared/in-flight crash through a controlled loopback proxy without changing production retry policy
observe the real DeepSeek sender, AgentRuntime, RunStore, CLI, TUI and app-server instead of copying retry classification or reducers into the evaluator
score only deterministic applicable information facts and require identical semantic facts in en and zh-Hans
prove server attempt count, stored physical/retry accounting, event replay and SQLite reopen agree
make no production change unless the same missing fact repeats across at least two independent fault profiles
after treatment, require all applicable information facts, zero duplicate request, zero false progress and zero false success
slice.single_owner: Retry decisions remain exclusively in crates/runtime::AgentRuntime; typed transport facts remain in crates/deepseek; human projection changes may only be owned by crates/localization plus crates/tui or crates/cli.
slice.old_path_replaced: Only a measured silent or ephemeral human projection branch may be replaced. Runtime retry, RunStore truth, app-server sequence replay and same-Run resume are not candidate paths.
slice.evidence: credential-free controlled loopback proxy, real binary PTY/exec, canonical app-server events, SQLite reopen, process SIGKILL and exact accounting
slice.cutover_deletion: A kept candidate physically deletes the silent or ephemeral projection it replaces and any superseded helper. A failed or unsupported candidate is fully deleted; the frozen fixture, manifest and summary remain.
non_goals: changing retry count, 1s/2s backoff, Retry-After policy or replay safety
second retry controller, transport retry loop, settings page or modal
SSE token continuation, Last-Event-ID emulation or blind resend
Provider, Runtime, Store, prompt, model, permission or tool changes
LLM judge, external failure attack against official DeepSeek, GitHub, push or release

experiment.real_sleep: Only real CLI/TUI end-to-end profiles may observe the production 1s/2s waits; Runtime correctness remains fake-clock based.

adopted: observable error, attempt, wait and final outcome
stderr progress separated from stdout final output
saved session resume separated from upstream request retry
not_copied_without_evidence: random jitter for a single local Runtime
session resume described as partial token continuation
